paper_title: Bounds on heavy axions with an X-ray free electron laser
notes: Laboratory light-shining-through-wall Primakoff search at EuXFEL (HED/HiBEF). Headline bounds are the pink 'EuXFEL' curve in Fig.5, tabulated in Table I as g_agamma[GeV^-1] at five detuning angles / masses: (dtheta=0.0 mrad, m_a<=44 eV, 3.91e-4), (1.0 mrad, 340 eV, 3.10e-4), (1.8 mrad, 460 eV, 3.87e-4), (10.0 mrad, 1.1 keV, 3.69e-4), (50.0 mrad, 2.4 keV, 2.76e-4). The first (on-Bragg, dtheta=0) search is broadband, sensitive over a wide mass range up to the ~44 eV valence plasma frequency (Eq.2), so I represent it as a flat limit from 1e-3 eV to 44 eV at 3.91e-4; the other four are narrow off-Bragg searches (~1e-3 eV wide) centered at the listed masses. The bounds are 90% CL upper limits from observation of zero axion-consistent events (N_det=2.3, Eq.9). Not a DM search: g_agamma already in canonical L=g_agamma E.B a convention (Eq.1), Heaviside-Lorentz, so no conversion needed; dm_density null. The blue 'xi_B=1' region in Fig.5 is shown only to illustrate potential improvement and is NOT the headline result.
